acp_permission_request.approved_outcome: allow the selected option; turn continues in-session
acp_permission_request.denied_outcome: selected outcome rejected; no escalation is fabricated
acp_permission_request.timeout_effect: turn aborted and treated as unresolved
acp_permission_request.transport_lost_effect: transport marked lost; the task can never report success

full_mode.audit: the capability freeze is recorded in the permission_audit payload
